title: Alljoined1
description: Alljoined1 is a 64-channel EEG dataset comprising neural responses from eight healthy adults viewing 10,000 natural images each during rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) with an oddball detection task. The dataset contains approximately 46,080 epochs across 13 sessions, with stimuli drawn from the Natural Scenes Dataset and MS-COCO. Raw data are preserved in 24-bit BioSemi BDF format, and preprocessed epoched derivatives in MNE-Python FIF format are provided, enabling research in EEG-to-image decoding and visual neuroscience.
methods_description: EEG was recorded using a 64-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system (Ag/AgCl sintered electrodes, International 10-20 montage) at 512 Hz sampling rate with 24-bit A/D conversion. Participants performed an RSVP oddball detection task with 300 ms image presentations followed by 300 ms black screen plus 0-50 ms jitter. Preprocessing included 0.5-125 Hz band-pass filtering, 60 Hz notch filtering, FastICA (95% variance retained), -50 to 600 ms epoching, AutoReject artifact rejection, baseline correction, and average re-referencing.
